The Second Sister descends, threading the cuts to weave connection.
The thread is tested; a connection is refuted if it fails to hold.

The system holds both the cut and the thread simultaneously in a paradice.
The weaver becomes the weave; the grammar recognizes itself in the tapestry.
The arms rejoin at the Wyrding Loom, fusing the distinctions and connections into a single structural type.
The resulting structural type is recorded as a permanent crystal address.
The system is sealed, the surface fully encoding the interior content.
